feature: Fix AGENTS.md: hooks table, glob-scoped rules section, ACAM date
problem: AGENTS.md has three classes of staleness: (1) Hooks table lists 6 hooks but hooks.json has 10 registered; chain-evaluator.sh event is wrong (says 'stop', is actually 'subagentStop'); (2) 5 glob-scoped rules exist in .cursor/rules/ but are undocumented; (3) ACAM Status date is 2026-06-12 and Multi-agent row still says 'manual /evaluator only' despite chain-evaluator now auto-dispatching.
proposed_solution: Edit AGENTS.md only. Three surgical edits: update hooks table to 10 rows with correct events; add a 'Glob-Scoped Rules' subsection after 'Agent-Requested Rules'; update ACAM date and Multi-agent evidence cell.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 [STRENGTHENED]: Hooks table in AGENTS.md contains exactly 10 hook script rows (header and separator excluded) — one for each of: harness-context.sh(sessionStart), harness-gate.sh(beforeSubmitPrompt), contract-gate.sh(preToolUse Write), evaluator-guard.sh(preToolUse Write), dedup-server.sh(beforeShellExecution), pre-commit-harness.sh(beforeShellExecution), chain-evaluator.sh(subagentStop), verify-harness.sh(stop), enforce-progress.sh(stop), context-health.sh(stop). Verification: awk '/## Hooks/,/^## [A-Z]/' AGENTS.md | grep -E '^\|.*\.sh' | wc -l — must output 10.
AC2 [ACCEPTED]: chain-evaluator.sh row shows event 'subagentStop' (not 'stop'). Verification: grep 'chain-evaluator' AGENTS.md | grep -c 'subagentStop' — must return 1.

AC3 [STRENGTHENED]: A 'Glob-Scoped Rules' section or subsection exists listing all 5 rules (architecture.mdc, causal_rigor.mdc, python_ml.mdc, research_standards.mdc, testing.mdc) AND each entry includes its glob pattern. Name check: grep -cE 'architecture\.mdc|causal_rigor|python_ml|research_standards|testing\.mdc' AGENTS.md — must return exactly 5 (one match per name). Glob check: awk '/Glob-Scoped/,/^## [A-Z]/' AGENTS.md | grep -cE '\*\*|\{py|\{py,ipynb' — must return ≥3 (at least 3 of the 5 entries expose a glob pattern with wildcard or brace syntax).

AC4 [STRENGTHENED]: ACAM Status date updated from 2026-06-12 to 2026-07-14 and old date removed. Verification (new date present): grep -c '2026-07-14' AGENTS.md — must return ≥1. Verification (old date absent): grep -c '2026-06-12' AGENTS.md — must return 0.

AC5 [STRENGTHENED]: ACAM Multi-agent row evidence updated to reflect chain-evaluator.sh auto-dispatch on subagentStop; the phrase 'manual /evaluator only' must no longer appear in that row. Verification (evidence present): grep -i 'Multi-agent' AGENTS.md | grep -icE 'auto-dispatch|chain-evaluator|subagentStop' — must return ≥1. Verification (stale text removed): grep -i 'Multi-agent' AGENTS.md | grep -c 'manual.*evaluator only' — must return 0.
edge_cases: EC1 [ACCEPTED]: AGENTS.md line count stays under 250 after additions. Verification: wc -l AGENTS.md — reported count must be < 250.

EC2 [STRENGTHENED]: Hooks table note 'Copy to .cursor/hooks/ to activate' remains verbatim (must not be inadvertently removed during hooks table rewrite). Verification: grep -c 'Copy to .cursor/hooks/ to activate' AGENTS.md — must return 1.
verification_method:
Run these commands from repo root in sequence:
1. awk '/## Hooks/,/^## [A-Z]/' AGENTS.md | grep -E '^\|.*\.sh' | wc -l  # expect 10
2. grep 'chain-evaluator' AGENTS.md | grep -c 'subagentStop'  # expect 1
3. grep -cE 'architecture\.mdc|causal_rigor|python_ml|research_standards|testing\.mdc' AGENTS.md  # expect 5
4. awk '/Glob-Scoped/,/^## [A-Z]/' AGENTS.md | grep -cE '\*\*|\{py'  # expect ≥3
5. grep -c '2026-07-14' AGENTS.md  # expect ≥1
6. grep -c '2026-06-12' AGENTS.md  # expect 0
7. grep -i 'Multi-agent' AGENTS.md | grep -icE 'auto-dispatch|chain-evaluator|subagentStop'  # expect ≥1
8. grep -i 'Multi-agent' AGENTS.md | grep -c 'manual.*evaluator only'  # expect 0
9. wc -l AGENTS.md  # expect < 250
10. grep -c 'Copy to .cursor/hooks/ to activate' AGENTS.md  # expect 1
